Interface DatabaseScope

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Implementing Classes:
MainDatabaseScope, TestDatabaseScope
public interface DatabaseScope extends AutoCloseable
Opens database work for the app. Callers borrow a connection, do their work, and either save everything (commit) or undo it (rollback).
